implementedBehavior: Persisted and candidate lock fork IDs are supplied to inventory on every update apply, so project-owned fork report ownership remains recognized on unrelated later updates.

Runtime lock loading rejects unknown fields, malformed source identity and timestamps, unsupported scopes, invalid policy or ownership combinations, malformed fork contracts, duplicate references, invalid digests and paths, and unresolved or self references before plan or apply mutation.

Update dispatch accepts only the explicit valued options project, mode, skills, assets, and selection-file plus the dry-run, apply, accept-risk, and json flags; unknown options and positional arguments fail closed before mode defaulting.

Fork apply copies the complete local package first, journals the complete canonical package directory, removes it, and rebuilds every canonical package member from upstream; rollback restores the directory digest exactly and removes transaction-created fork outputs.

The approved project guide remains unchanged while reports/project-guide.json is rebound to current guide and Project Understanding evidence; a repository test now enforces all three hashes, and the documentation-plan sequence contradiction is corrected.
